title: Quarterly Convergence Sprint: Hosted API runway and model readiness matrix
creator: Alyssa Chen
description: Goal: Produce a consumable, prioritized quarterly roadmap that ties hosted API launch windows to model catalog readiness and capacity forecasts. Scope includes: finalizing model candidates for Q2 hosted tiers, slotting canary windows for each model variant, defining readiness gates (eval + infra + QA), and publishing the runbook for rollout and rollback. Deliverables: readiness matrix (per-model readiness state), capacity hedge recommendations, canary schedule, evaluation prompt sets, and a cross-functional runbook. This ticket coordinates PM, Eng, and Design workstreams and surfaces risks up to leadership for resourcing decisions.
objectives_and_okrs: OKR-1: Decrease hosted-model rollout time by 20% by end of Q2 — deliverable: streamlined canary schedule and automated gating
OKR-2: Ensure 95% of Q2 hosted models meet latency SLO targets in pre-prod — deliverable: readiness matrix and infra sizing recommendations
OKR-3: Reduce unit cost variance across model variants by providing quantization/selection guidance — deliverable: cost/perf playbook for top 10 models
milestones: 2025-02-20: Initial model shortlist and owner mapping completed
2025-03-03: Runbook draft (canary + rollback) reviewed by Eng and SRE
2025-03-10: Readiness matrix first-pass completed with perf/quality tags
2025-03-24: Capacity hedge proposal and slot allocation approved by infra finance
2025-04-01: Finalized canary calendar and published runbook to Confluence
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Model fails latency SLO in pre-prod for long-tail sequences — Mitigation: reserve burst dedicated capacity and flag as delayed rollout
Risk: Insufficient labeling/eval coverage for regression detection — Mitigation: expand prompt sets and pair with customer-sim test cases
Risk: Cross-team scheduling conflicts cause canary slippage — Mitigation: block weekly cross-functional syncs and publish immutable canary windows 2 weeks prior
Risk: Observable gaps in Console for token-level cost by route — Mitigation: temporary dashboard with sampling and tie to release checklist
